operations.description: Tenant sessions target their own scope. Platform sessions retain their platform actor scope. Only this collection GET may omit target_scope_id to list assets across active tenants, with live certificates.read authorization. An explicit target limits the collection to that tenant. Detail and write operations still require an explicit platform target.

params.name: target_scope_id
params.description: Required for platform detail and write operations; optional for the collection GET to list active tenants. Forbidden when it differs from a tenant actor scope.

params.name: status
params.type: string: normal / expiring / expired / auto_renew / manual_renew
params.description: normal/expiring/expired by the latest version (expiring: active or default and expiring within 30 days; expired: not_after passed); auto_renew/manual_renew by whether an auto-renewing order issued the asset.

params.name: domain
params.description: Advanced search (CERT-05); every advanced filter narrows items, total and counts alike. A SAN of any version contains it, case-insensitive.

params.name: domains
params.description: Comma-separated domains; the latest version's SANs contain every one exactly (case-insensitive). At most 100.

params.name: user
params.description: The recorded owner's display ID, username, email or phone contains it.

params.name: certificate_id
params.description: The asset display ID contains it.

params.name: dns_provider_id
params.description: The DNS provider of the order that issued the asset.

params.name: expiry
params.description: within30/within90 are latest versions in force (active or default, not expired) expiring within 30/90 days; expired is a passed not_after. Expired assets are never within30/within90.

params.name: auto_renew
params.description: Whether an auto-renewing order issued the asset.

params.name: issue
params.description: issued is an asset issued by an order; failed is an asset whose issuing order or one of its renewal orders failed.

params.name: sync
params.description: Publication of the asset's current site bindings; failed when one permanently failed, complete when every one succeeded and its apply rollout has every node deployment healthy, pending otherwise. An unbound asset matches none.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Assets under search and status.

fields.name: counts
fields.description: Assets per status under search (not status), over every page.

operations.summary: Upload a certificate and private key
operations.description: Requires certificates.manage. The private key crosses this request boundary once, is encrypted by the certificate store, and is never returned in a response. Exact replay uses the same request body, X-Request-ID and Idempotency-Key without adding facts. owner_user_id records an active member of the target tenant and is immutable. Tenant uploads default to the actor and cannot assign another user. For compatibility, platform clients may omit owner_user_id; these assets remain legacy_unknown. The admin UI requires explicit ownership. Omitted-owner legacy requests retain their original idempotency digest and receipt ownership.

params.name: target_scope_id
params.description: Required for platform detail and write operations; optional for the collection GET to list active tenants. Forbidden when it differs from a tenant actor scope.

params.name: Idempotency-Key
params.description: Retry an unknown result only with this exact key and unchanged request.

fields.name: owner_user_id
fields.description: Active target-tenant member. Immutable after creation. Tenant actors may only select themselves; omitted platform ownership stays unknown for legacy clients.

fields.name: remark
fields.description: Optional; trimmed, no control characters. Part of the idempotency digest.

fields.name: private_key_pem
fields.description: Never returned by this API.

responses.description: Certificate asset created or exactly replayed
